request: Keep seasonal themes visible when rotating from portrait to either landscape orientation
rootCause: The runtime SeasonalSelectionInput and both full-screen preview views rejected compact vertical size class, intentionally removing all seasonal decoration in landscape. The earlier149 rotation check verified navigation and return but wrongly accepted this product behavior.
changes: Keep active/public and private-preview theme selection through compact orientation; retain user opt-out, section/account eligibility and accessibility-size safeguards.
Use height-aware reduced decoration scale on short wide displays; align the static web and first spider through shared geometry; shorten spider descent, bound Santa and firework dimensions.

Map gravity and acceleration from device coordinates into current interface axes and reset only motion calibration on orientation changes. Do not recreate the theme or restart its arrival clock merely because of rotation.
Use full-display screenshots for physical landscape evidence; app-window capture previously clipped the rotated frame.
Resolve snow-bank width from the real native tab-item UIControl frames, preserving language-dependent floating-bar width; do not use private UIKit classes or fixed screen-wide assumptions.
